div.head: Northu 19
div.ab: Gif man ciricgrið abrece, bete be circan mæðe ⁊ be þam þe hire mund sy.
If anyone violates sanctuary, he is to pay compensation in proportion to the status of the church and according to what its right of protection is.
If anyone violates church sanctuary, compensation is to be paid according to the status of the church and according to its degree of protection.
Wenn jemand den Sonderschutz einer Kirche verletzt, büsse er nach dem Range der Kirche und je nachdem wie [theuer] ihre Schutzgewalt ist.
If anyone breaks the special peace of a church, let him atone according to the rank of the church and according to how [costly] its protection is.
div.note: Liebermann compares VIII Atr 4 f. = I Cn 3 f.
